title: Re-stage Biome fixes in npm run fast so commits keep them
body:
Outcome: npm run fast re-stages Biome fixes to files that were fully staged before it ran.
Why: on 2026-11-09 the lead ran git add -A then npm run fast then git commit; Biome rewrote test/rules/instruction-bytes.test.ts after the add, the commit kept the unformatted file and the rebase stopped on the unstaged fix (#509).
Proof: a test stages a file, simulates the Biome rewrite and sees no unstaged diff after the restage.
Scope: scripts/fast-check.ts, test/fast-check.test.ts.
